people.name: Rimmon
people.line: Rock where Benjamites fled after battle

translations.web: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, and stayed in the rock of Rimmon four months.
translations.bsb: But 600 men turned and fled into the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, where they stayed four months.
translations.kjv: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.
translations.asv: But six hundred men turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon, and abode in the rock of Rimmon four months.
